source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Palace on Campus
tts_text: In September, the new academic year brings a thousand new students to Jiangcheng Academy. Every freshman carries a heavy bag and a light heart. Every undergraduate carries a heavy schedule too. The dormitory doors open at eight, and the campus is loud all day. On the first morning, a tall boy named Han stood in front of the old building called the Palace. Long ago, people say, a prince and a princess once lived there. Now it holds the offices of the principal and the dean. The principal spoke about one principle: work first, play later. Han's discipline is computer science, but he also loves art. The dean of the faculty told him to read one journal a week. Every Friday there is a seminar, where the experts on the faculty answer questions. Students also talk on the online forum. A senior scholar there helped him interpret a difficult paper. Slowly he learned how to interact with teachers and how to ask good questions. At the interval of the meeting, he met a girl who was the school champion at running. She was leading a campaign to recycle paper on campus. In the afternoon Han had an interview for a scholarship. His family's tuition was high, and the scholarship could cover half of it. The teachers did not intervene; they only listened. The interview was hard, but he stayed calm. In the winter, his whole class went to a training camp in the hills. Nobody could interfere with that week, and nobody wanted to.
sentences: In September, the new academic year brings a thousand new students to Jiangcheng Academy.
Every freshman carries a heavy bag and a light heart.
Every undergraduate carries a heavy schedule too.
The dormitory doors open at eight, and the campus is loud all day.
On the first morning, a tall boy named Han stood in front of the old building called the Palace.
Long ago, people say, a prince and a princess once lived there.
Now it holds the offices of the principal and the dean.
The principal spoke about one principle: work first, play later.
Han's discipline is computer science, but he also loves art.
The dean of the faculty told him to read one journal a week.
Every Friday there is a seminar, where the experts on the faculty answer questions.
Students also talk on the online forum.
A senior scholar there helped him interpret a difficult paper.
Slowly he learned how to interact with teachers and how to ask good questions.
At the interval of the meeting, he met a girl who was the school champion at running.
She was leading a campaign to recycle paper on campus.
In the afternoon Han had an interview for a scholarship.
His family's tuition was high, and the scholarship could cover half of it.
The teachers did not intervene; they only listened.
The interview was hard, but he stayed calm.
In the winter, his whole class went to a training camp in the hills.
Nobody could interfere with that week, and nobody wanted to.
sentences_cn: 九月，新的学年把一千名新学生带进江城学院。
每个新生都背着一个沉书包，揣着一颗轻快的心。
每个本科生的课表也一样沉。
宿舍八点开门，校园里整天都吵吵嚷嚷。
第一天早上，一个叫韩的高个子男生站在那栋叫“宫殿”的老楼前。
据说很久以前，一位王子和一位公主曾住在这里。
如今这里是校长和院长的办公室。
校长只讲了一条原则：先做事，后玩耍。
韩的专业是计算机，但他也喜欢艺术。
院长让他每周读一本期刊。
每周五有一场研讨会，系里的专家们在那里回答问题。
学生们也在网上论坛里聊天。
那里一位资深的学者帮他解释了一篇难懂的论文。
慢慢地，他学会了怎么和老师互动，怎么提出好问题。
会议中场休息时，他遇见了一个女生，她是校里的跑步冠军。
她正在发起一场校园纸张回收活动。
下午，韩参加了一场奖学金的面试。
他家要交的学费很高，而奖学金能抵掉一半。
老师们并没有干预，只是听着。
面试很难，但他一直很镇定。
那年冬天，他整个班去山里的一处训练营地。
没人能打扰那一周，也没人想去打扰。

words.mnemonic: inter表示中间，来来回回的行 动(act)，就是“相互影响，相互作用”。
words.zhenti: They scored higher on social interaction. 他们在社交互动方面得分更高。(2016) 例 You have to understand how cells interact. 你必须得了解细胞之间是如何相互作用的。
words.sentence: how to interact with teachers
words.root: inter(在……之间) + act(行动) → 你来我往地动 → 相互作用
words.family: interaction n. 互动 / interactive adj. 交互的

words.mnemonic: inter 在……中间，如 international (国际的);fere发音类似“飞”，该单词可以解释 为：在中间来来回回地飞。可以想象成你在学 习，一只苍蝇来来回回地飞，它在“干涉，干预” 你的学习。
words.zhenti: Most of us may sometimes feel the frustration of having old memories interfere with new，relevant memories. 我们大多数人有 时会因为旧记忆干扰新的相关记忆而感到沮 丧。(2017)
words.sentence: Nobody could interfere with that week
words.root: inter(中间) + fere(撞) → 插到中间乱撞 → 干涉，阻碍
words.family: interference n. 干扰

words.mnemonic: vene 的发音类似“went(走)”， 那在中间(inter)来来回回地走，这是在干什么？ →斡旋，调停。
words.zhenti: They have ways to intervene in people's aging process. 他们有办法干预人们的衰老过程。
words.sentence: The teachers did not intervene
words.root: inter(中间) + vene(来) → 来到中间 → 调停，干预
words.family: intervention n. 干预

words.mnemonic: inter(在……中间)；val(发音 似“我”)。我在小树中间，隔一棵小树有个“我” →间隔。
words.zhenti: They can begin to time the interval between the flash and the crash to learn how close they were to the actual spark. 他们可以 (第五单元) 开始计算闪电和撞击之间的时间间隔，以了解 它们离实际火花有多近。
words.sentence: At the interval of the meeting
words.root: inter(中间) + val(墙) → 两墙之间的空 → 间隔；幕间休息
words.family: interval n. 间隔 / at intervals 每隔一段

words.family: interviewer n. 面试官 / interviewee n. 面试者

words.zhenti: The findings are in the journal Nature Geoscience.研究结果发表在《自然地球科学》期 刊上。(2017)

words.root: journ(日) + al → 每天写的东西 → 期刊；日记
words.family: journalist n. 记者 / journalism n. 新闻业

words.mnemonic: 在两个人中间(inter)提前(pre) 替他(t)说话，就是在替一个人“解释，说明”。
words.zhenti: It is interpreted differently in different times.它在不同的时代有不同的解释。(2022)
words.sentence: helped him interpret a difficult paper
words.root: inter(在中间) + pret(说) → 在两边之间说 → 口译；解释
words.family: interpretation n. 解释 / interpreter n. 口译员

words.cn: 大学教师，学者 adj. 学业的，学术的
words.mnemonic: 挨个（aca的谐音）点名（dem） 的，“大学老师”一上课就开始挨个点名。
words.zhenti: It is essential to a person's future academic success. 这对一个人未来的学业成功至关重要。 (2016) 例 A group of academics say they can predict (111) house prices through a computer program. - 批学者声称，他们可以通过一种电脑程序预测 房价。

words.root: academy(学院) + ic → 学院的，学术的；学者
words.family: academy n. 学院 / academically adv. 学业上

words.mnemonic: ac表示“一再地”；ca发音类似 “开”；de发音类似“的”；my“我的”。连到一起 就是一再地(ac)开(ca)的(de)朝我的(my)。只 要坚持努力，所有的“研究院”和“学院”都会为 你敞开。
words.zhenti: Likewise, I don't hear people in the academy saying. 同样地，我也没有听到学院里 的人说。
words.sentence: new students to Jiangcheng Academy
words.root: 谐音「一再开」：一再敞开的地方 → 学院，研究院
words.family: academic adj. 学术的

words.cn: 学者；有学问的人，奖学金获得者
words.mnemonic: 该单词发音类似“思高了”。 “学者”是思考到一定高度的人。
words.zhenti: Scholars and policymakers have different opinions about it. 学者和政策制定者对此有不 同的看法。(2016)

words.family: scholarly adj. 学术的 / scholarship n. 奖学金

words.zhenti: It phased out its merit-based scholarships altogether.它完全取消了基于成绩的奖学金。

words.family: scholar n. 学者 / scholar 也可指奖学金获得者

words.mnemonic: 该单词发音类似“涩迷哪儿”。 眼睛在哪又涩又迷糊，想睡觉？在“研讨会”上。 (112)

words.mnemonic: 这个单词可以拆分为：fo（近似 for“为了”),rum(发音类似 room)，连在一起即 是：为了房间。如果你考研，要在学校旁边租房 子，你一般去哪儿找房子？学校的“论坛”是个 好地方，有很多合租信息。
words.zhenti: Goel and his team sourced the online discussion forum to find all 40,000 questions. 戈尔和他的团队在在线论坛上找到了所有的 4万个问题。

words.mnemonic: 该单词发音类似“土一身”。 “富家不用买良田，书中自有千钟粟。”需要通过 “教学”才能实现。
words.zhenti: The tuition they charge has been rising considerably. 他们收取的学费一直在大幅上涨。
words.sentence: His family's tuition was high

words.family: tutor n. 导师，家教

words.mnemonic: 该单词发音类似“翻考题”。学 院里的“全体老师”翻开考题进行阅卷。
words.zhenti: They will bring with them more international faculty. 他们将带来更多国际化的师资。
words.sentence: the experts on the faculty answer questions

words.cn: 系主任；(大学的)学院院长

words.sentence: the offices of the principal and the dean

words.family: deanery n. 院长职位

words.cn: 校长；首长 adj. 最重要的,主要的

words.zhenti: The employee posted abroad who speaks the country's principal language has an opportunity to fast-forward certain negotiations. 派驻海外的员 工如果能说该国的主要语言，就有机会加快某 些谈判的进程。
